sections.text_helper: Section 12.3.6 "SBS hardware secure storage control" in chapter 12 (System configuration, boot, and security (SBS)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 360.
sections.section_content:
This feature ensures the isolation of keys including the key derivation (DHUK) mechanism
protecting data using a hardware key different for the identified domains.
[Figure 39. SBS hardware secure storage control]
• sbs_next_hdpl: select secure storage context for current HDPL, or greater ones. This
signal is set thanks to the SBS_NEXTHDPLCR register. This information is used by the
SAES when processing the derived key to generate a key derived related to HDPL
context.
All keys encrypted using the SAES/DHUK inherit of the RHUK property: unique per device.
